name: Xian Yu
statement: I trained in architecture, and I build small digital tools that make space easier to see, test and understand.
about: I studied architecture, and my work now sits between design and computation: 3D models, browser-based tools and data that help people read a space before they stand in it.

My current research is a phone-based study of how people feel about privacy and safety in a transparent public toilet in Tokyo. Participants walk through a 3D model built from the plan and site photos, and their answers go straight into a dataset.

education.title: Master of Architecture (in progress)
education.org: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST)
education.detail: Research on environmental perception: how a building's transparency changes people's sense of privacy and safety.
